_comment: ATLAS Network config. gateUrl = the ATLAS Network Gate Worker URL (see network-gate/README.md); when set, launchers that support it show 'Connect with Discord' and join with a per-user single-use key instead of the shared authKeyB64. THE CLEAN CUT: after the Discord-gated launcher ships, set gateUrl to your Worker URL and blank authKeyB64 ("") so old launchers can no longer join (they show 'unavailable'), killing the shared-key botting path. authKeyB64 is the base64 of a Tailscale auth key (legacy shared path). loginServer stays empty for Tailscale cloud.
